ai_positioning.summary: Equifax erkennt die wachsende Bedeutung von künstlicher Intelligenz und maschinellem Lernen in seinen Operationen und regulatorischen Compliance-Rahmenbedingungen an. Das Unternehmen erwähnt ausdrücklich die Nutzung von AI und maschinellem Lernen zur Datenanalyse und Erstellung personalisierter Insights-Lösungen. Regulierer und Gesetzgeber verstärken ihre Überwachung von Algorithmen, AI und maschinellem Lernen, was einen wachsenden Risikorahmen für das Unternehmen darstellt.
evidence: MD&A: 'We use advanced statistical techniques, artificial intelligence and machine learning, as well as proprietary software tools to analyze available data for the creation of customized insights, decision-making and process automation solutions'

Business: 'Multiple jurisdictions, including the EU and several U.S. states, have adopted comprehensive oversight laws related to the development and use of artificial intelligence and additional countries and U.S. states are expected to enact comprehensive artificial intelligence regulatory framework statutes'

Business: 'There are also pending legislative proposals to regulate business use and development of artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies which, if enacted, could impose new legal requirements addressing among other issues, privacy, discrimination and human rights'
